name: Enrenchuu no Toshishita Kanojo ga Onna ni Ueta Osuzaru-domo no Gakuen de Koubi Aite ni Sareteta.
original_name: 遠恋中の年下彼女が女に飢えた雄猿共の学園で交尾相手にされてた。
source: Himezaki Naho entered a long-distance relationship with her boyfriend after he left for a university in another prefecture. In order to be with him, Naho decides to attend the same school as her boyfriend, which until the previous year had been an all-boys school with a dormitory and no female students. One day, two classmates visit Naho's room and invite her to study together, which she hesitantly agrees to.
translation: 姬崎奈穗在男友前往另一个县的一所大学就读后，与男友建立了异地恋关系。为了和他在一起，菜穗决定和男友上同一所学校，直到前一年，这所学校还是一所男校，有宿舍，没有女学生。有一天，两名同学来到奈穗的房间，邀请她一起学习，奈穗犹豫不决地答应了。
